Libraries

Library API blocks, and libraries that have no typed API.
The TypeScript definitions behind each API block are maintained in the library data repo — generated from the upstream sources that ship machine-readable types, and hand-forked where upstream ships none — and pinned to an upstream commit or tag.
A card marked with the no-typed-API icon links to a page describing what the library ships and how to use it, but it has no typed API.
271 namespaces documented.

defold (official)

asset-pbr

A base metallic-roughness PBR material with vertex and fragment shaders under /defold-pbr. No Lua API — content, shaders, build-time tooling or engine-side native code only.

assets-defold

Defold logos to use on splash screens or other kinds of in-game promotions for Defold No Lua API — content, shaders, build-time tooling or engine-side native code only.

codepad

Online Defold compiler/interpreter Lua API not typed — upstream ships no .script_api, so resolve skips it.

defold-pbr

A work-in-progress PBR core with shaders, a material, a reference render script and the defold-pbr/core Lua module. Lua API not typed — upstream ships no .script_api, so resolve skips it.

defwarez-shared

Shared DEFWAREZ files: the defwarez-shared/defwarez Lua module, a render script, a font, an atlas, input bindings and a mock collection for local testing. Lua API not typed — upstream ships no .script_api, so resolve skips it.

defluid

Create 2D fluid simulations based on metaballs. No Lua API — content, shaders, build-time tooling or engine-side native code only.

defold-fake-real-glass/fake_real_glass

A multipass glass rendering library for Defold with screen-space double refraction, thickness-based distortion, optional color absorption and local cubemap reflection probes. Supports lighting from Defold light components and configurable reflection modes that update probes every frame, capture once or use pre-rendered cubemaps. Includes a reusable Lua render module, glass materials and example scenes with glass spheres, a wine glass and planar mirror reflections. Integrates with custom render pipelines and requires Defold 1.14.0 or newer.
